name: Automobiles

mofsl_2qfy27.headline: Demand outlook strong; margins to remain under pressure in 3Q as well
mofsl_2qfy27.read: Retail was strong, channel inventory lean and exports grew strongly. Coverage margins were broadly flat YoY despite steel, rubber and copper inflation; aggregate OEM EBITDA margin printed 10.3% in 2QFY27 against 10.5% in 1QFY27, and aggregate ancillary margin 12.3% (excluding CIE). M&M and TMPV were the 4W laggards (M&M tractor margin contracted; its Auto business gained 60bp QoQ). Guidance: 2W industry mid-to-high single digit in 2HFY27, PV domestic high single digit, CV high-single to low-double digit in 3Q; M&M cut tractor guidance from mid-single digit to flat; MSIL sees ~10% domestic growth in 2HFY27. MOFSL left FY27/FY28 estimates materially unchanged.

unit_economics: OEM EBITDA = units x (realisation per vehicle - RM and other cost per vehicle) + incentives; realisation = list price - discounts + mix; commodity basket (~18% of revenue in PV and 2W) passes through with a one-quarter lag and partial price recovery.

price_drivers.why: Steel, rubber, copper and precious-metal costs rise ahead of price hikes; the share of cost recovered through hikes, mix and cost control decides EBITDA margin (aggregate OEM margin 10.3% in 2QFY27).
Share gains in SUVs, 150cc+ motorcycles and exports earn more per vehicle than entry cars and 100cc bikes; wholesale share can run ahead of retail share.

price_drivers.driver: Retail demand versus dispatches and channel inventory
price_drivers.why: Dispatches above registrations build dealer stock that is cut back next quarter; lean stock in 2QFY27 supports 2H volumes.
PLI and state SGST accruals sit inside EBITDA for EV-led OEMs; GST rate cuts, CAFE III and PLI expiry in FY28 change the earnings base.
Export realisation per unit exceeds domestic; Bajaj and TVS margins move with USD/INR in the same quarter, Maruti with JPY.

kpis.name: House EBITDA margin (ex other income, ex incentives)
kpis.definition: Operating EBITDA on revenue from operations after removing treasury income, PLI and state grants and named one-offs.
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Stocks react to margin versus consensus, not volume: Maruti printed 8.2% in 1QFY27 against ~9.6-10.0% expected. Incentive-free margin shows what survives after PLI ends in FY28.
kpis.history_source: get_financials for P&L lines (revenue from operations, material cost, employee, other expenses, other operating revenue); broker results-update notes in the report library (Motilal Oswal tables carry 8 quarters); get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'EBITDA margin' for company-reported margin.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates for Bloomberg Sales/EBITDA/PAT/EPS; broker models for incentive-free margin (no consensus exists for ex-PLI margin); company guidance from transcripts (Hyundai guides margin, Maruti and M&M do not).
kpis.traps: Other operating revenue carries PLI/grants (Bajaj ~22% of FY26 EBITDA); Maruti margin basis moved from EBIT to EBITDA; Ather/Ola divide by total income; SMG merger breaks Maruti's standalone series.

kpis.name: EBITDA per vehicle
kpis.definition: House EBITDA divided by total units (domestic, OEM supply, exports).
kpis.formula: House EBITDA / total units (Rs per vehicle)
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Rising volume with falling EBITDA per vehicle means growth is hiding a unit-margin squeeze (Maruti ~Rs87-92k in FY26 quarters to ~Rs63k in 1QFY27); the market re-rates on per-unit recovery.
kpis.history_source: Derived: get_financials EBITDA divided by dispatch volumes from get_investor_presentation (metric filter 'volume' or 'dispatches'); broker results notes (Kotak, Motilal) publish EBITDA per vehicle.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus field; derive from get_consensus_estimates EBITDA divided by broker volume forecasts, or take broker models.
kpis.traps: Units basis differs (Maruti domestic includes Toyota supply and LCV; TVS EV includes exports); street figures include incentives.

kpis.name: Market share by segment (retail, VAHAN) and wholesale gap
kpis.definition: Registration share within a named segment (SUV, 125cc+, scooter, e-2W) and wholesale minus retail over three months.
kpis.formula: Company registrations / segment registrations; (wholesale - VAHAN) over 3 months
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Wholesale share gains that outrun retail (Maruti +230bp wholesale vs falling VAHAN share in festive weeks) reverse as dealers destock; retail share in growing segments is what sustains volume growth multiples.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation with metric filter 'market share' and 'retail'; transcripts for company share claims; sector reports in the library (Nuvama, JM, MOFSL monthly auto notes) for VAHAN and SIAM series. VAHAN/SIAM primary data is outside Airavat.
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; broker sector notes and company guidance on volume growth in transcripts.
kpis.traps: Share bases differ (Bajaj 8-14% depending on base); VAHAN omits Telangana; festive timing shifts Q2/Q3.

kpis.name: Price hikes versus commodity cost (recovery ratio)
kpis.definition: Realisation gain from price (ex mix) divided by commodity cost increase over the same base.
kpis.formula: Price realisation gain / commodity cost increase (cumulative, same base)
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Margins track the recovery ratio with a 1-3 quarter lag; OEMs with taken price (M&M 5.3% hikes Jan-Sep 26) defend margin, those with ~1% hikes (Maruti, Tata PV) see gross margin fall.
kpis.history_source: Company margin walks in transcripts (get_qa, search_research); get_financials material cost % of revenue; commodity series via get_commodity_prices (steel, aluminium, copper, rubber).
kpis.estimate_source: No consensus; broker notes (Nomura, Kotak, Axis) publish hike tables and gross margin forecasts; get_consensus_estimates EBITDA as an output check.
kpis.traps: Hike announcements differ from retained price after discounts; inventory absorption moves margin 30-60bp and reverses.

kpis.name: Export volume share and USD/INR sensitivity
kpis.definition: Exports as a share of volume and revenue, with export price per unit and realised FX.
kpis.formula: Export units / total units; export revenue / export units
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Exports earn above domestic margins (Hyundai ~2x profitability) and a weaker rupee lifts Bajaj and TVS margin in the same quarter; Nigeria and LatAm swings change the mix.
kpis.history_source: get_investor_presentation metric filter 'exports'; get_financials segment data; transcripts for USD/unit and hedged rates; SIAM export data via sector reports.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models (Kotak, Jefferies) and company commentary; no Bloomberg export field.
kpis.traps: Bajaj hedge gains sit in revenue; Maruti exports include Toyota supply to Africa.

kpis.name: EV share and PLI/state incentive dependence
kpis.definition: EV volume or revenue share, and incentives as a share of EBITDA.
kpis.formula: PLI + grants / house EBITDA; EV units / total units
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Incentives above 10-15% of EBITDA mean the margin falls when PLI ends in FY28; EV margin ex-PLI near zero caps a premium multiple.
kpis.history_source: get_financials other operating revenue and grant lines; annual report notes via library (read_library_document); transcripts for PLI accrual; get_investor_presentation 'EV'.
kpis.estimate_source: Broker models only; company-level PLI accrual has no consensus field.
kpis.traps: PLI sits in other income statutorily but inside deck EBITDA at TMPV; quarterly split rarely disclosed.

kpis.name: Ancillary growth versus industry production (content per vehicle)
kpis.definition: Component maker revenue growth minus relevant vehicle production growth, with realised content per vehicle.
kpis.formula: Company revenue growth - weighted OEM production growth
kpis.why_it_moves_price: Outperformance over production from content gains and new orders earns premium multiples; commodity pass-through lags squeeze margin in the first quarter.
kpis.history_source: get_financials revenue and EBITDA; get_investor_presentation metric filter 'order win' and 'content per vehicle'; broker results notes.
kpis.estimate_source: get_consensus_estimates for Sales/EBITDA; broker models for outperformance assumptions.
kpis.traps: Acquisitions, JV look-through, grants and other income inside EBITDA, and order-win values that are lifetime not annual.

valuation_anchor: P/E on core EPS (ex treasury and incentives) for PV and 2W; EV/EBITDA with SOTP for TMPV, M&M and Eicher (VECV); EV/EBITDA for ancillaries; mid-cycle margin cross-check.
watch_next_quarter: Per MOFSL, near-term input cost headwinds persist through 3Q, so track retained price hikes, mix and cost control against margin; 3Q festive retail, post-GST-2.0 base effects, M&M tractor guidance (cut to flat), TMCV's high-single to low-double digit industry view and export momentum.
